title: Pure Exchange of the Spirit
summary: Ishizu Ishtar's Exchange of the Spirit EARTH Fairy graveyard-control build, paired with the Vernusylph EARTH Fairy engine and Herald of Orange Light. With Exchange of the Spirit in the GY and Gravekeeper's Trap on the field, the opponent is locked out of their GY while Zolga the Prophet reveals the top of their Deck so Gravekeeper's Trap strips every card they draw.

summary.title: Starters
points: Mudora the Sword Oracle (Limited) discards 1 EARTH Fairy to Special Summon itself and place Gravekeeper's Trap face-up directly from your Deck.
Keldo the Sacred Protector (Limited) discards 1 EARTH Fairy to Special Summon itself and search Exchange of the Spirit, Gravekeeper's Trap, Zolga the Prophet, or Blast Held by Destiny.

Vernusylph of the Misting Seedlings and Vernusylph of the Awakening Forests discard themselves and a monster to search or send Keldo, Mudora, or Zolga the Prophet from the Deck while reviving an EARTH monster from the GY.

summary.title: Opening: Vernusylph of the Misting Seedlings + EARTH Fairy
steps: Discard Vernusylph of the Misting Seedlings and an EARTH Fairy to search Mudora the Sword Oracle (or Keldo the Sacred Protector) and Special Summon the discarded Fairy from the GY.
Discard another EARTH Fairy to Special Summon Mudora the Sword Oracle, placing Gravekeeper's Trap face-up from the Deck.

Use Gravekeeper's Trap (discarding Exchange of the Spirit or sending it via Foolish Burial Goods) to search Zolga the Prophet, then Special Summon Zolga from the hand to look at the top 5 cards of both Decks.
Overlay two Level 4 EARTH Fairies into Number 41: Bagooska the Terribly Tired Tapir or Time Thief Redoer, with Keldo and Mudora in the GY ready to Quick-Effect shuffle up to 5 cards from either GY.

summary.title: Gravekeeper's Trap & Zolga Lock
summary.text: While Exchange of the Spirit is in your GY, Gravekeeper's Trap prevents your opponent from activating any card effects in the GY or Special Summoning monsters from the GY. Furthermore, at the start of the opponent's Draw Phase (before they draw), Gravekeeper's Trap lets you declare 1 card name; if the opponent draws that card, it is immediately sent to the GY. Because Zolga the Prophet reveals the exact order of the top 5 cards of both players' Decks when Special Summoned, you know every card the opponent will draw for the next five turns.

summary.title: Control & GY Shufflers
points: Keldo the Sacred Protector and Mudora the Sword Oracle banish themselves from the field or GY as a Quick Effect to shuffle up to 3 cards (or up to 5 if Exchange of the Spirit is in your GY) from either GY into the Deck.
Herald of Orange Light discards itself and an EARTH Fairy (putting Keldo or Mudora into the GY even on Turn 0) to negate and destroy an opponent's monster effect.

Number 41: Bagooska the Terribly Tired Tapir forces all monsters into Defense Position and negates activated effects of Defense Position monsters while Gravekeeper's Trap strips the opponent's normal draws.

summary.title: Spells & Traps
points: Foolish Burial Goods and Foolish Burial (both Limited) send Exchange of the Spirit or Keldo/Mudora directly from the Deck to the GY to activate your GY lock immediately.

Exchange of the Spirit fulfills the GY requirement for Gravekeeper's Trap, Keldo, Mudora, and Blast Held by Destiny, and can be activated if both GYs reach 15+ cards to swap each player's GY with their Deck.
Blast Held by Destiny destroys the opponent's highest-ATK monster on attack declaration to inflict burn damage, and banishes itself from the GY to recover a Level 4 EARTH Fairy.

summary.title: Left out
summary.text: Kelbek the Ancient Vanguard and Agido the Ancient Sentinel are Forbidden in the TCG, so the classic TCG-legal Level 4 EARTH Fairies Kelbek and Mudora take their slots alongside the Vernusylph engine.

main: Keldo the Sacred Protector

Limited to 1 in TCG: discards 1 EARTH Fairy to Special Summon itself and search Exchange of the Spirit or any card that mentions it, and banishes itself from field/GY as a Quick Effect to shuffle up to 5 cards from either GY into the Deck.
Mudora the Sword Oracle

Limited to 1 in TCG: discards 1 EARTH Fairy to Special Summon itself and place Gravekeeper's Trap face-up directly from your Deck, and banishes itself from field/GY as a Quick Effect to shuffle up to 5 cards from either GY into the Deck.
Zolga the Prophet

Ishizu's Level 4 EARTH Fairy that Special Summons itself from the hand while you control an EARTH Fairy (except Zolga) and looks at the top 5 cards of BOTH Decks—guaranteeing you know the exact top card of the opponent's Deck to snipe it with Gravekeeper's Trap!
Kelbek
Original TCG-legal Level 4 EARTH Fairy from Ishizu's deck that returns any monster that attacks it back to the owner's hand and fuels discard costs for Gravekeeper's Trap and Vernusylphs.
Mudora
Original TCG-legal Level 4 EARTH Fairy that gains 200 ATK for every Fairy monster in your GY.
Vernusylph of the Misting Seedlings
Discards itself and 1 monster to search ANY Level 4 EARTH Fairy (Keldo the Sacred Protector, Mudora the Sword Oracle, or Zolga the Prophet!) from your Deck and revive an EARTH monster.
Vernusylph of the Awakening Forests
Discards itself and 1 monster to send Keldo the Sacred Protector or Mudora the Sword Oracle directly from your Deck to the GY and revive an EARTH monster.
Vernusylph of the Flourishing Hills
Discards itself and 1 card to search another Vernusylph and protect your EARTH monsters from effect destruction.
Herald of Orange Light
Unlimited in TCG: discards itself and an EARTH Fairy from hand to negate and destroy an opponent's monster effect, putting Keldo or Mudora into the GY on Turn 0.
Gravekeeper's Trap

Core Continuous Trap: while Exchange of the Spirit is in your GY, prevents your opponent from activating card effects in the GY or Special Summoning from the GY; discards 1 card to search any Level 4 EARTH Fairy; and declares the card your opponent draws to send it to the GY (100% accurate with Zolga the Prophet!).
Exchange of the Spirit
Signature Trap that swaps both players' GYs with their Decks when both GYs have 15+ cards, and serves as the required GY enabler for Gravekeeper's Trap, Blast Held by Destiny, Keldo, and Mudora.
Blast Held by Destiny
Signature Trap searchable by Keldo that destroys the opponent's highest-ATK monster on attack declaration to burn for its ATK, and banishes itself from the GY to recover a Level 4 EARTH Fairy.
Foolish Burial Goods
Limited to 1 in TCG: sends Exchange of the Spirit directly from the Deck to the GY so Gravekeeper's Trap's GY floodgate is immediately live.
Foolish Burial
Limited to 1 in TCG: sends Keldo or Mudora directly from the Deck to the GY.
